(ns sample.call-implementations
  (:require [clojure.test :refer [deftest is]]))
(defn protocol-target [x] x)
(defn multi-target [x] x)
(defprotocol Operation (operate [this x]))
(defrecord OperationImpl [] Operation
  (operate [_ x] (protocol-target x)))
(defmulti dispatch identity)
(defmethod dispatch :a [x] (multi-target x))
(deftest reaches-implementations
  (is (= :a (operate (->OperationImpl) :a)))
  (is (= :a (dispatch :a))))
